page.overview:
Who is Law?

Appeared in the G.I. Joe: Renegades episode "Busted." Christopher "Law" Lavigne is a prison guard who works at a prison with his dog Order. He is displeased with the warden's illegal fight activities. When Flint and Lady Jaye storm the prison, Christopher saves Flint from two inmates. Category:Renegades Characters
